sentiment: What we put away does not stop; it keeps running in the dark, waiting for the light to find it again.

stories.title: A searchable library of forgotten public-domain film clips from 1915 onward
stories.summary: A century of discarded footage, indexed and made findable again. The film never stopped existing; it only stopped being looked at, which is not the same as being gone.

stories.title: Flip Fluid on Flip Dots
stories.summary: A fluid simulation driven by a wall of physical flip-dots — a slow mechanical display that turns dark discs to light one flip at a time. Old hardware still runs, just on its own clock.

stories.title: Does Georgism work? Five years later
stories.summary: A century-old economic idea, put away and mostly forgotten, gets checked again against the real world. The question was never closed; it was only shelved.
